newsitem.title: ITALY: European car market seen up 12 pct in Sept - Anfia.
newsitem.headline: European car market seen up 12 pct in Sept - Anfia.

text.p: Europe's car market, still moving in an opposite direction to Italy's, grew 12.3 percent year-on-year in September with some 964,200 new registrations, Italian carmakers' association Anfia said.
Excluding Italy, where the market fell 8.55 percent, European demand rose 16 percent, Anfia said in a statement.
In the January-September period, sales in Europe posted a 6.6 percent rise to around 9.97 million vehicles. Excluding Italy, the rise was 8.0 percent.
Provisional data showed booming sales in France where they were up 86 percent to over 216,000 cars in September, the last month valid for car-scrapping incentives, Anfia said.
In Spain, where the government has reduced car registration taxes, sales rose 18.6 percent. In Germany, sales rose just 1.0 percent while they fell 2.0 percent in Britain.
